output.summary: The backlog growth is driven by the per-agent quota, not demand or capacity. First-contact issues rose only 4%. Staffing and scheduled hours are essentially flat, and closes per agent rose from 11.7 to 19. Splits, duplicates and reopens grew sharply: the reopen rate went from 6% to 23%, and splits and duplicates rose from 240 and 410 in June to 3,710 and 2,770 in October. Quick-win picking replaced oldest-first, and complex aged tickets tripled. The exempt Billing-Compliance pod stayed stable, and the reopen-rate report definition and reopen trigger were unchanged since 2024-2025. Payroll is a minor contributor. Engineering bugs may contribute but are unverified. Suspend the quota in favour of quality measures and classify the aged tickets. Defer hiring, and do not escalate the quota.
